component.name: 2fip
component.summary: Dual-pane file manager inspired by Total Commander

description.p: 2fip (2 File Panel) is a keyboard-driven, dual-pane file manager for the COSMIC desktop, inspired by Total Commander.

ul.li: Two panels with tabs, each with its own folder, history and view
Classic function keys: F5 copy, F6 move, F7 new folder, F8 delete
Copy, move, delete and compress in the background, with progress
List view with Name, Ext, Size and Modified columns, or a grid view
Thumbnails, quick filter, favorites, folder sizes and Find Files
Drag and drop between the panels and other apps
SFTP, FTP and FTPS servers, with saved connections
Color themes, and translations into several languages

description.p: The first Windows downloads:

ul.li: A Windows installer that works without admin rights, and a portable zip that keeps its settings next to the program
No changes to the Linux version

description.p: Small fixes:

ul.li: Folder Size: the hand pointer only shows over what can be clicked (rings and folder rows), not over the whole window
Favorites: double-click a favorite to open it in the active panel

description.p: A built-in viewer, Quick View and better editing:

ul.li: F3 shows text, hex and images inside 2fip; big files open at once, with search
Quick View (Ctrl+Q): the other panel previews the file under the cursor; Alt+F4 quits
Choose the F4 editor in Settings; Shift+F4 creates a new file and opens it
Files edited with F4 on a server are uploaded again each time they are saved
Operations wait in a queue, with a list of what is waiting
Packing uses all processor cores for tgz, txz and 7z, and several files at once for zip

description.p: Opening files and a cleaner toolbar:

ul.li: Programs such as AppImages run when opened, instead of going to the web browser
Files whose type has no default app open the Open With list, with "Always use this app"
The selection stays when switching panels and after a refresh
Several files are packed into an archive named after their folder
Toolbar buttons are plain icons, greyed out when they can't act

description.p: Archives, drives and a folder tree:

ul.li: Pack files into zip, tar, gz, tgz, xz, txz or 7z (zip and 7z with a password), with "Move to archive"
Extract archives, next to them or into the other panel, with or without their folders
Open archives like folders and copy, move or delete files inside them
A drive menu in each panel with USB sticks and other disks, mounting and safe eject
A folder tree beside the left panel, the right, or both
Optional lines between rows in the list view
Cancel in the "file already exists" dialog

description.p: Rubber-band selection and readable selections:

ul.li: Drag a rectangle from empty space in the list or grid to select files and folders; Ctrl adds to the selection
A click on empty space clears the selection
Selected files' text stays readable with light accent colors, such as Monokai Pro, Matrix and Catppuccin Macchiato

description.p: Folder Size for a whole drive:

ul.li: With nothing selected, Folder Size analyzes the current folder, such as / or C:\
A bar shows the drive's used, total and free space, and what could not be counted
Sizes are the space on disk, hard-linked files count once, and the scan stays on one drive
Progress while scanning, with a Cancel button

description.p: A Total Commander shortcut:

ul.li: Shift+F6 renames the selected file or folder, like F2

description.p: Search results as a list:

ul.li: View in Listbox, in Find Files, shows all results as a tab in the active panel, where they can be opened, viewed, copied, moved, renamed or deleted like files in a folder
Nothing can be copied, moved, pasted or dropped into such a results tab

description.p: Smaller text, a Windows theme and a faster Folder Size:

ul.li: File name size goes from Medium (14 px) down to Tiny (10 px); rows and icons shrink with the text, also in the Folder Size panel
Windows is now a color theme instead of a separate checkbox
Folder icons line up with the text
Folder Size scans folders on all CPU cores, no longer freezes while the mouse moves over the chart, and shows the 500 largest entries per folder

description.p: Fix the automatic refresh:

ul.li: Folders refresh only when files are added, removed, renamed or changed, no longer in a loop that could steal the keyboard focus

description.p: Panels refresh themselves:

ul.li: Folders reload automatically when their contents change on disk, without polling
Switching panes or returning to the window refreshes the active folder

description.p: Readable tooltips in every theme:

ul.li: Tooltip text now always contrasts with its background, fixing the black-on-black tooltips in the light theme

description.p: Folders, favorites and the panel layout:

ul.li: Folder Size: see what is taking up space inside a folder
Favorites: a warning when the folder you are saving is already a favorite, naming the entry it clashes with
List view: drag the dividers to resize the columns, remembered per tab
Settings: rounded corners in four steps, and a Windows-style appearance
Copying and moving: rename on the spot when a name is already taken

description.p: Servers, saved connections and new icon styles:

ul.li: Browse SFTP, FTP and FTPS folders in a panel, and copy, move, rename and delete there with progress (Ctrl+K)
Connections panel: saved connections with their status, open, reconnect, disconnect; passwords stored in the system keyring
Delete permanently, without the trash (Shift+Delete)
Drag a tab to the other panel to open a copy; double-click beside the tabs for a new one
Help menu with an online user's guide (F1)
New icon styles: Vivid, Windows style and macOS style

description.p: New app icon: two file panels, teal and slate blue, each with a folder and files.
New app icon: two 3D file panels, cyan and orange, each with a folder and files.
The Refresh and Find tooltips are readable with the System theme in light mode (they showed dark text on a dark background).

ul.li: F9 finds an installed terminal on any distribution (GNOME Console, Ptyxis, Konsole, Xfce and more), starting it in the panel's folder; in Distrobox it falls back to the host's terminal
The Refresh and Find tooltips are readable with every theme

description.p: The Flatpak now works like a regular install:

ul.li: F9 opens the terminal
Open With lists all installed apps, including other Flatpak apps
F4 opens the text editor again
Thumbnails for PDFs and videos

description.p: First release.
